summary.text: Jeff McNeely is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 84 who has served since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner, he is listed by the General Assembly as owner of G&M Milling.

paragraphs.text: McNeely was born in Statesville, North Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree from North Carolina State University in 1986.
His career experience includes being a small business owner.
McNeely assumed office in the North Carolina House on July 5, 2019, succeeding Rena W. Turner.
The General Assembly's website lists him as representing Iredell County.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Agriculture and Environment and Transportation committees and is vice chair of the Appropriations, Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources Committee.
